name: Striploin with Charred Green Onion Sauce & Lemon-Parsley Roasted Beets

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium beets
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim beets; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until beets are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, trim green onions. Place on a plate, drizzle with oil, and season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, working in batches, add green onions. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side; return to the plate. (Reserve grill pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on another plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return the pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Add to the plate with the green onions, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, water, and spices in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp avocado oil mayonnaise
3 tbsp water
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Mince grilled green onions. Add to the bowl with the yogurt sauce and whisk once more to combine. Set aside.
Juice lemons into a small bowl. Add oil, Dijon, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide green onion yogurt and beets between plates; top yogurt with steak and drizzle beets with dressing. Enjoy!
